newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia expects final national rail bids soon.
newsitem.headline: Australia expects final national rail bids soon.

text.p: Final bids for the purchase of Australian government-owned rail operator Australian National were expected by the end of July, a government spokesman said on Monday.
"We'll be looking to get those in by the end of July," a spokesman for Finance Minister John Fahey told Reuters.
In May, Fahey said the government had drawn up a shortlist of about 12 companies interested in AN or some of its assets from more than 50 expressions of interest.
AN operates freight services and workshops in South Australia and Tasmania, in addition to three interstate passenger services.
